spec.name: aegis-supply-chain
spec.description: A local-first software supply-chain assessment, bounded remediation, evidence, and draft-only delivery control plane.

operations.name: assessRepository
operations.description: Evaluate one immutable repository revision and return evidence plus a draft-only publication decision.

types.name: AssessmentRequest
types.definition: { runId: string; baseCommit: string; repository: RepositoryFixture; policy: unknown; evaluationTime: string; idempotencyKey: string }

types.name: AssessmentResult
types.definition: { runId: string; status: 'green'|'red'|'cancelled'; findings: Finding[]; evidenceDigest: string; publication: DraftPublication|null }

types.name: CancellationResult
types.definition: { runId: string; cancelled: boolean; evidenceRetained: boolean }

types.name: RepositoryFixture
types.definition: { files: { path: string; sha256: string; content: string }[]; provenance: unknown[]; vulnerabilities: unknown[] }

types.name: Finding
types.definition: { id: string; severity: 'low'|'medium'|'high'|'critical'; waived: boolean; remediable: boolean }

types.name: DraftPublication
types.definition: { draft: true; baseCommit: string; title: string; body: string; idempotencyKey: string }

implementation.composition: Bind the immutable base, inventory components and provenance, evaluate policy, plan and verify permitted remediation, build evidence, then ask the operator domain for a draft-only decision. Cancellation closes admission without deleting evidence.

cases.name: idempotent-assessment-reuse
cases.harness: const first = assessRepository(fixtures.repairedGreen); const second = assessRepository(fixtures.repairedGreen); assert.equal(first.evidenceDigest, second.evidenceDigest); assert.deepEqual(first.findings, second.findings);

properties: same canonical request yields byte-identical findings and evidence digest
no result can request a non-draft publication

implementation.composition: Pass the root-produced inventory into the Python planner, then verify paths, preimages, content policy, manifest/lockfile consistency, affected tests, and idempotent application with the Go verifier. Both leaves use versioned newline-delimited canonical JSON over stdio and the verifier invokes only a network-denied sandbox adapter.

implementation.composition: Canonicalize and hash every evidence item, construct the ordered audit chain, then create an in-toto-compatible attestation bound to the index digest. Verification recomputes the index before invoking audit-attestor verification. Go leaves use versioned newline-delimited canonical JSON over stdio.

The Go API uses versioned newline-delimited canonical JSON over stdio; external HTTP and Git hosting remain replaceable adapters outside deterministic core evaluation.
